# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Clover-35B-A3B brings diffusion models into agent work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/clover-diffusion-agent-model.html): Diffusion Intelligence released Clover-35B-A3B, an open preview that targets coding, tool use and browser agents with faster parallel generation.
- [Kimi adds Gmail, Drive and Calendar connectivity](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/kimi-workspace-connectors.html): Moonshot says Kimi can now work across Gmail, Google Drive and Calendar, turning the assistant from a chat interface into a cross-app work layer.
- [Ant Group open-sources Ling-3.1 Flash for persistent agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ant-ling-31-flash-1019-open-source.html): Ant Group’s Bailing team released Ling-3.1 Flash 1019 with stronger long-horizon reasoning, tool use, memory, and workflow automation.
- [Genspark introduces persistent machine environments for agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/genspark-persistent-agent-machines.html): Genspark says its agents can run inside isolated machines with their own kernels, persistent state, rollback, and usage-based execution.
- [Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4 world simulation model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-genie-4-world-model.html): Genie 4 generates interactive worlds with native audio, real-time steering and stronger physical continuity, but remains a limited research preview.
- [Google proposes sleep cycles for continual LLM learning](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-sleep-framework-continual-learning.html): Google Research introduces a wake-and-sleep training loop that consolidates new knowledge into model parameters while targeting catastrophic forgetting.
- [Liquid AI releases six open-weight LFM3 models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/liquid-ai-lfm3-open-models.html): Liquid AI’s LFM3 family brings text, vision, audio and decision models to a shared 2B-class backbone designed for local specialization.
- [MiniMax H3 Community Builds Cut Video Generation Costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/minimax-h3-community-video-audio.html): New community contributions show MiniMax H3 generating reference-controlled video and audio in as few as four to eight denoising steps.
- [Tencent Open-Sources Low-Latency Simultaneous Translation Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy-simulmt-open-source.html): Tencent has released Hy-SimulMT, an open Chinese-English simultaneous speech translation model that reports roughly three seconds of StreamLAAL on the RealSI long-form benchmark.
- [Tsinghua Open-Sources AKV to Cut Agent Inference Costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tsinghua-akv-agent-cache.html): Tsinghua and CUHK researchers released AKV, an Apache-licensed SGLang server that reduces agent inference costs by editing KV cache visibility.
- [Nvidia opens Flora to cut robot-video labeling costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-flora-robot-data-engine.html): Nvidia has open-sourced Flora, a robotics data engine that labels 200,000 hours daily and claims a 125-fold cost advantage over GPT-6 Astra.
- [Cursor gives coding agents control of desktop apps](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-computer-use-desktop-agents.html): Cursor’s new Computer Use feature lets coding agents click and type across desktop software, including simulators used to test mobile apps.
- [Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with 3T-class scale](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/kimi-k31-pro-launches.html): Moonshot’s new Kimi K3.1 Pro combines a 1M-token context window, tool use and multimodal workflows with immediate API access.
- [OpenAI removes live internet from frontier training](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-frontier-training-offline.html): OpenAI says its frontier-model training environments will no longer use the live internet after security testing exposed containment weaknesses.
- [Apple Makes Xcode Projects Easier for Coding Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/apple-xcode-json-agent-projects.html): Xcode 27.2 adopts a smaller JSON project format designed to reduce merge conflicts and make automated code editing safer.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [扩散智能发布Clover，扩散模型进入Agent主场](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/clover-diffusion-agent-model.html): 扩散智能推出35B级Clover预览版，瞄准代码、工具调用和浏览器Agent，并以并行生成争取更低延迟。
- [Kimi接入Gmail、Drive和Calendar，扩展工作助手边界](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/kimi-workspace-connectors.html): 月之暗面宣布Kimi接入Gmail、Google Drive和Calendar，可汇总邮件、查找文件并协助安排日程。
- [蚂蚁开源 Ling-3.1 Flash，瞄准持续工作的个人智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ant-ling-31-flash-1019-open-source.html): 蚂蚁百灵发布 Ling-3.1 Flash 1019，强化长程推理、工具调用、跨会话记忆和复杂工作流执行能力。
- [Genspark推出持久化机器环境，让智能体可长期运行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/genspark-persistent-agent-machines.html): Genspark公布面向智能体的隔离机器环境，支持独立内核、持久状态、回滚和按运行时长计费。
- [谷歌发布Genie 4，推进实时世界模拟](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-genie-4-world-model.html): Genie 4可生成带原生音频、实时操控和更强物理连续性的互动世界，但目前仍处于受限研究预览阶段。
- [谷歌提出“睡眠”机制，让大模型持续学习新知识](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-sleep-framework-continual-learning.html): 谷歌研究团队提出交替进行唤醒与睡眠训练的框架，试图让大模型持续吸收知识并缓解灾难性遗忘。
- [Liquid AI发布LFM3，推出六款开放权重多模态模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/liquid-ai-lfm3-open-models.html): Liquid AI发布LFM3系列，将文本、视觉、音频和决策模型统一到约20亿参数级别的共享骨干上，主打本地微调与端侧运行。
- [MiniMax H3社区方案将视频生成推向低步数推理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/minimax-h3-community-video-audio.html): MiniMax展示H3社区的新方案，可用4至8步去噪生成受参考素材控制的视频与音频，降低推理成本。
- [腾讯开源低延迟中英同传模型 Hy-SimulMT](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy-simulmt-open-source.html): 腾讯混元开源 Hy-SimulMT，面向中英实时语音翻译，并在RealSI长音频基准上报告约3秒StreamLAAL。
- [清华开源 AKV，降低长程智能体推理成本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tsinghua-akv-agent-cache.html): 清华与香港中文大学团队开源 AKV，通过管理智能体的 KV 缓存可见性，在多项测试中平均降低推理成本 27.7%。
- [英伟达开源Flora，机器人视频标注成本降125倍](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-flora-robot-data-engine.html): 英伟达开源机器人数据引擎Flora，称其每天可处理20万小时数据，标注成本约为GPT-6 Astra的八分之一百二十五，即约低125倍。
- [Cursor让编程代理接管桌面应用操作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-computer-use-desktop-agents.html): Cursor推出Computer Use，让编程代理可点击和输入桌面软件，并操作iOS模拟器测试刚生成的功能。
- [月之暗面发布3T级旗舰模型Kimi K3.1 Pro](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/kimi-k31-pro-launches.html): 月之暗面推出Kimi K3.1 Pro，支持百万级上下文、工具调用和多模态工作流，并同步开放API。
- [OpenAI将前沿模型训练改为断开互联网](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-frontier-training-offline.html): OpenAI宣布前沿模型训练环境不再接入实时互联网，此举源于安全测试暴露出的隔离缺陷。
- [苹果让 Xcode 项目文件更适合编程代理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/apple-xcode-json-agent-projects.html): Xcode 27.2 默认采用更小、更清晰的 JSON 项目格式，旨在减少合并冲突并提升自动化改项目的安全性。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
